script.problem: It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.

terra.problem: The verses do not say Simon carried the cross all the way to Golgotha; they say he was forced to carry it and that Jesus was brought there.

The line attributes the statement that Jesus saved others but could not save Himself to the passersby as well as the chief priests and scribes. Only the chief priests and scribes are said to have made it.
The women are not said to have watched from a distance in Galilee. They had followed and ministered to Jesus in Galilee.
